story_type: 28 survivors adrift in life rafts after a fishing boat fire, plane circles, tanker picks them up
hook: 28 people adrift in life rafts after their boat burned.
narration: Twenty eight people, adrift in life rafts in the Caribbean.
Their fishing boat had burned, forty six miles southwest of Serranilla Bank.
A Coast Guard Hercules found the rafts and circled overhead.
A plane cannot pick anyone up. It can only watch.
outcome: Then a giant tanker, the Challenge Pollux, pulled all twenty eight from the water.
title: 28 people adrift after their boat burned
description:
A Coast Guard Air Station Clearwater HC-130 crew circled life rafts holding survivors of a fishing vessel fire southwest of Serranilla Bank, Colombia, on Sept. 15, 2018. The 774-foot tanker Challenge Pollux rescued 28 people with the Coast Guard and the Colombian Navy.

Footage: U.S. Coast Guard video courtesy of Air Station Clearwater, via DVIDS: https://www.dvidshub.net/video/625641/28-rescued-after-fishing-boat-catches-fire
